theorems.name: Submission.dimred_rpd_massOn_eq_mult_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M W : Set (Euclid P)) (m₀ : ℤ) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → MeasurableSet M → ContinuousOn ξ M → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q) → μHE[n] (M ∩ W) ≠ ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → T ω = m₀ * ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → T.massOn W = (m₀.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n] (M ∩ W)
